newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS LIFE CALLS CONVERTIBLE BOND.
newsitem.headline: SWISS LIFE CALLS CONVERTIBLE BOND.

text.p: Swiss Life/Rentenanstalt said its coporate executive board had decided to prematurely withdraw a two percent convertible bond issue.
The conversion period for the bond, issued at two percent from 1995 to 1998, begins on September 29, 1997.

"Up to October 10, 1997, convertible bonds at a nominal value of 380 Swiss francs may be converted into Swiss Life/Rentenanstalt bearer shares at a nominal value of 50 francs each, free of charge," Swiss Life said.
Its bearer shares closed at a price of 810 francs on August 6. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
